name: OpenRouter aggregator (openrouter.ai/api/v1)
keyless_reason: the model catalogue is public; only inference needs a key. Fleet OR keys: OPENROUTER_API_KEY is EXPIRED (provider row notes 'free promo lane only') — GITREINS_OPENROUTER_KEY and MYTHOS_OPENROUTER_KEY answer 200 (verified 2026-09-24 on stealth/space-bunny-alpha).
price_scale_reason: OpenRouter quotes USD PER TOKEN (pricing.prompt/completion); every lane in our tables is priced per 1M tokens. Without this the whole provider imports 1e-6x too cheap.

plan_tier_policy.reason: aggregator = PAYG, no subscription pool: plan_tier stays null like the other 376 openrouter rows (a numeric tier here re-buckets PAYG lanes and changes chain order)

notes: onboarded as a preset 2026-09-24 so pricing/model refreshes go through the importer instead of a one-off script (TR-064 pattern)
:batch variants are legitimate cheaper lanes (half price) and are imported as separate lanes
sentinel guard: openrouter/fusion reports pricing -1000000 (a router placeholder); _scaled_price keeps such values NULL rather than importing a price that would win every chain
capability flags (vision/thinking) are deliberately NOT mapped: OpenRouter exposes a modality STRING, and bool('text->text') is True for text-only models — mapping it would corrupt the flags
cache rates mapped from pricing.input_cache_read/write (295/458 OR models publish them); models that omit it stay NULL
basis_note: public_price = 0.96*in + 0.04*out (list blend); normalized_price = input price (normalized_from=price_in) — both measured against 347/347 existing openrouter lanes, so a refresh writes only REAL catalog changes.

variant_notes.z-ai/glm-5.3-prime: throughput SKU (2026-09-24): GLM-5.3 at 1.5-2x output throughput for ~2x list — a speed purchase, not a price change
variant_notes.qwen/qwen3.8-max-prime: throughput SKU (2026-09-24): qwen3.8-max at higher throughput for ~2x list — separate SKU, higher price point
variant_notes.google/gemini-3.8-flash: INTRO PRICING 2026-09-24: 0.75/3.75 doubles to 1.50/7.50 on 2027-01-01 — re-check before any long-horizon plan
variant_notes.stealth/space-bunny-alpha: stealth free promo (2026-09-23): 0/0 while anonymous; name-watch for a real launch
